attractions.name: Candy Cane Mountains
attractions.description: Valley flanked by rolling shale mountains with red, orange, pink and chalk-coloured swirls, named by travel writer Mark Elliott; colours attributed to groundwater altering the oxidation state of iron compounds in the rock. Roughly midway on the Baku to Shahdag road
attractions._source_file: Azerbaijan and Georgia/Azerbaijan- All Inclusive Guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Shahdag Mountain Resort
attractions.description: Resort at the foot of Mount Shahdagh (4243 m) in the Greater Caucasus, near Shahdagh National Park; skiing and winter and summer sports, about 29 km from Gusar
